use_case: Generative AI document extraction in the tax software: reads scanned W-2, 1099, 1098, and K-1 forms and fills return input fields (drafting suggestions disabled)
vendor_or_model: Tax software vendor feature using an AI sub-processor (generative document understanding model)
data_categories: Scanned source documents with names, SSNs, income, withholding, and bank details (tax return information; GLBA customer information)
consequential_decision_category: None (tax preparation data entry; not a consequential decision category)
human_in_the_loop: Preparer verifies low-confidence, critical, and photographed-document fields; reviewer signs off; ERO transmits only after Form 8879 is signed
status: Pilot (8 preparers, extraction only); approved with conditions due 2026-10-31; expansion decision 2027-01-05

use_case: Enterprise generative AI assistant in the productivity suite for drafting client letters and IRS and state notice responses
vendor_or_model: Productivity suite vendor (enterprise generative AI assistant)
data_categories: Prompts with notice text and amounts; client names and SSNs prohibited until counsel confirms the IRC 7216 basis
human_in_the_loop: A CPA or enrolled agent checks every citation and amount and signs every item sent
status: Pilot (15 users); approved with conditions due 2026-10-31

use_case: Public generative AI chatbots used by staff to rewrite notice text
data_categories: Client names and notice text were pasted in 3 known cases
applicable_laws: IRC 7216 (unauthorized disclosure, 26 CFR 301.7216-1(a)) (N54-R02); 16 CFR 314.4(j) if 500 or more consumers were affected (N54-R01)
status: Prohibited (POL-05 4.9); blocking on firm devices by 2026-10-31
